entries.odia: ଜର ଅଇଲା ଧାନକୁଟା ବେଳକୁ ଜର ଛାଡ଼ିଲା ଭାତ ଫୁଟା ବେଳକୁ
entries.title: A fever with pointed timing
entries.literal_meaning: Fever came at paddy-pounding time; fever left at rice-boiling time.
entries.explanation: The paired arrivals make the timing conspicuous: illness accompanies one stage of food preparation and disappears at another. Our reading hears a possible teasing suspicion about avoiding the harder work. The source does not prove that anyone pretended to be ill, and boiling rice is not yet eating it. The contrast can carry an accusation without making that accusation true.
entries.meaning_odia: ଖାଦ୍ୟ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତିର ଗୋଟିଏ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ ଜର ଆସେ, ଅନ୍ୟ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ ଛାଡ଼େ—ଦୁଇ ସମୟକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ି କଥାଟି ନଜର ଟାଣେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ କଠିନ କାମ ଏଡ଼ାଇବା ପ୍ରତି ଟାହିମିଶା ସନ୍ଦେହ ଶୁଣାଯାଇପାରେ। କେହି ମିଛରେ ଅସୁସ୍ଥ ହୋଇଥିଲେ ବୋଲି ଉତ୍ସ ପ୍ରମାଣ ଦିଏନାହିଁ; ଭାତ ଫୁଟିବା ମଧ୍ୟ ଖାଇବା ନୁହେଁ। ବିରୋଧରେ ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଆସିପାରେ, ତାହା ସତ ହୋଇଯାଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading notices suspicious timing without treating it as proof of pretence.
entries.odia_summary: ସମୟର ମେଳରେ ସନ୍ଦେହ ଉଠିପାରେ, ଛଳନାର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: In a reading discussion, someone quotes the two timings and laughs at the apparent convenience. Another points out that illness can change and asks what the line actually establishes. This imagined exchange separates a joke from evidence about a sick person.
entries.cultural_context: The dictionary defines fever abatement. No medical explanation, diagnosis, work instruction or documented household incident is established; the teasing inference is editorial.

entries.odia: ଆଶା ଲୁବଧରେ ପୂରିଲା କାଳ, ଷଣ୍ଢ ପଛେଧାଇଁ ମଲା ଶିଆଳ
entries.title: Following an expectation too far
entries.literal_meaning: Life ran out in hope and greed; the fox died chasing after the bull.
entries.explanation: The first clause names hope and greed; the second gives them a fatal pursuit. The dictionary places the quotation under avarice. Our reading follows the cost of staying with an expectation until nothing is left for anything else. The line does not say what the fox hoped to obtain or how it died; no remembered fable is supplied to fill those gaps.
entries.meaning_odia: ପ୍ରଥମ ଖଣ୍ଡ ଆଶା ଓ ଲୋଭ କହେ, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଖଣ୍ଡ ସେଥିରେ ମରଣାନ୍ତକ ପିଛାକରିବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଦିଏ। ଅଭିଧାନ ଉଦ୍ଧୃତିକୁ ଲୋଭ ଅର୍ଥରେ ରଖିଛି। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଶା ପଛରେ ଲାଗି ଅନ୍ୟ ସବୁ ପାଇଁ ସମୟ ସରିଯିବାର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଦେଖାଯାଏ। ଶିଆଳ କଣ ପାଇବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଥିଲା ବା କିପରି ମଲା, କଥାଟି କହେନାହିଁ। ମନେଥିବା କୌଣସି କାହାଣୀରେ ସେହି ଫାଙ୍କ ପୂରଣ କରାଯାଇନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Hope and greed become a fatal pursuit; its precise object remains unnamed.
entries.odia_summary: ଆଶା ଓ ଲୋଭର ପିଛାରେ ଜୀବନ ସରେ; ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟବସ୍ତୁ ଅନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: A hobby club keeps postponing its modest exhibition while waiting for an unconfirmed grand venue. A member quotes the fox-and-bull line and suggests deciding what can actually be arranged. The invented application concerns time spent chasing a possibility, not a prediction of disaster.
entries.cultural_context: The separate Jagannath–Bhagabata example illustrates the earlier poetic adjective; it is not credited as author of this saying. Animal imagery is literary, not zoological evidence.
